authorization: User explicitly approved the bounded research-process pilot after being told it changes the question; investment returns exploratory.
question: Does an LLM produce more useful predictive factor discoveries than adaptive grammar search at the same proposal-slot budget?
scope: Exploratory research-process benchmark on already inspected development history; not a fresh holdout, alpha-null test or original-paper reproduction.

model.model_choice_basis: Existing working canonical metering route and code-generation capability, selected before new pilot outcomes, not highest historical investment return.

features: Split-adjusted close only; strictly trailing momentum, volatility and distance from moving average. Static legacy US50 universe and data/model historical-knowledge limitations retained. No raw licensed security data or ticker identities are sent to the model.
target: Five-session forward dividend-inclusive total return from t+1 to t+5; predictive IC only, not a tradable execution/return claim.
purge: Target horizon end must lie inside each scored split; never labels crossing the split endpoint.
evaluation: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC on finite prediction/target pairs, at least20stocks. Coverage and missing labels retained. No future-driven feature filling.
orientation: Learn sign on training meanIC only; use that same sign for validation and assessment.
fitness: Training oriented meanIC; require coverage >=.95 for parents and final candidate eligibility.
adaptive_grammar: Round1 random legal expressions; later75% proposals use mutation/crossover over up to6 highest training-fitness parents,25% fresh expressions. Independent seeded proposal RNG, no outcome-selected retry.
feedback: Both arms receive only the same type of training-fitness parent summaries; LLM receives no validation/assessment score, dates, tickers or raw security-level observations.
failure_policy: Every invalid, duplicate, missing/truncated or excess-response proposal remains recorded against its slot; no replacement or paid network retry.
duplicate_rule: Canonical structural duplicates plus identical oriented training-prediction rank fingerprints are not credited as new discoveries.
selection: After all rounds, highest validation meanIC among valid >=.95-coverage initial/proposed candidates; ties by canonical expression. Validation/assessment sign is never refitted.
primary_process_endpoint: Assessment meanIC of validation-selected factor per arm/seed, with paired differences and all individual results reported descriptively; three seeds are not independent market histories.
secondary_endpoints: Novel validation hit yield: validation oriented meanIC>=.01 and coverage>=.95
Improvement over shared initial-bank validation selection
Provider cost, billed tokens, candidate evaluations and wall time separately
investment_returns: No new portfolio backtest is needed for this first process pilot. Predictive IC is not economic alpha.
private_public: Security-level inputs, factor matrices, raw responses, request identities and receipts remain private; public outputs contain aggregate metrics and factor expressions only.
canonical_transport: Unchanged CohortOpenRouter in runs/economic_fidelity/openrouter; only own new study requests may be added/settled. All old entries, charges, reservations and recovery map remain unchanged.
old_jobs: Do not alter existing held/dependent scientific jobs or completed archives/studies.
